gaps.title: Candidate search still dispatches acquisition
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Candidate search/schedules never invoke connectors; independently verify hourly central refresh.

gaps.title: Personal Job Pool admission and filter contract
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Current viable candidate records only; all requested filters/counts; stable paging; one job with multiple pathway assessments; no-CV search remains possible.

gaps.title: Non-Punt application creation
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Create candidate-directed application without false Punt promotion; retain assessment/risk policy and no-CV boundary.

gaps.title: Pipeline stage mapping and per-application state
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Agreed stage/event mapping; two independent applications; audited corrections and revision conflicts; no submission on package approval.

gaps.title: Punt history, counts and watched login reminders
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Persistent disposition history; full-data timezone-correct counts; one reminder per fresh login; per-Punt 14-day inactivity suppression; retain saved records.

gaps.title: Mailbox monitoring and interview lifecycle
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Separate mailbox consent/revocation; attributed reviewed events; persisted practice attempts/results; repeat/end/resume; agreed two-reminder abandonment policy.

gaps.title: A4 rich-text/export parity
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Same approved content/formatting through preview, edit, save, DOCX/PDF export; actual A4 pages; safe rich text.

gaps.title: Resumable onboarding and approval orchestration
gaps.acceptance_criteria: CV approval matches retained results and preserves selected job; retry-safe save/approve; conflicts/partial failures visible; resume across devices.

gaps.title: Saved-job visibility authorization
gaps.acceptance_criteria: Apply canonical visibility rules on save and list; deny foreign manual records and revoked visibility; regression tests.
